purpose: Give every bundled agent the full built-in Antigravity toolset and inherit the parent session's MCP servers and customizations; leave execution authorization to host/user settings.

frontmatter.tools: omitted — Antigravity's bundled-plugin default exposes all built-in tools
frontmatter.commandExecutionPolicy: omitted — do not pin a per-agent execution policy

notes: Do not add a tools property or tools: []; omission is intentional and grants the full built-in toolset to bundled plugin agents.
inheritMcp: true lets each agent inherit MCP servers and tools configured for its parent session.
inheritCustomizations: true inherits applicable workspace skills, rules, and hooks.
commandExecutionPolicy is omitted so the plugin does not impose a per-agent execution mode; Antigravity defaults and user/global/project/session settings govern execution.
Tool availability is not authorization. Antigravity host permissions, allow/ask/deny rules, sandboxing, workspace boundaries, and approval prompts remain authoritative.
Agent roles define responsibility and task ownership, not tool access. The Orchestrator remains the coordinator and single writer of shared execution state.
Keep canonical module agents and generated root agents synchronized.
